text:
pablo: quick flag from the orion-v3 int8 smoke: ZWSP (U+200B) inserted between Han and latin is being stripped in the canary outputs, causing line-wrapping differences and a small BLEU hit on ja->en samples (~0.4).

mei: repro'd locally. FP16 keeps the ZWSP; int8 canary output drops it and collapses tokens. Pre-tokenization ids match.

```
# repro (utf8)
echo -n "\u65e5\u672c\u200bhello world" | ./infer --model orion-v3 --quant int8 --input -
# output-int8: \u65e5\u672chello world
# output-fp16: \u65e5\u672c\u200bhello world
```

sanjay: looks like a postprocess behavior again. Which detok/postproc image is the int8 canary using?

anya: checked the canary manifest: int8 uses `postproc:2024-10-compat-lite` (pinned). fp16 uses `postproc:main` in the baseline runs. There are known differences in whitespace handling between those tags.

mei: i dumped the serialized token stream from the runtime before postproc: tokens are ["\u65e5\u672c", "\u200b", "hello", "world"] for both runs. After postproc in int8 job they become ["\u65e5\u672c", "hello", "world"] and then a naive join collapses boundary. So postproc dropped the ZWSP.

pablo: ZWSP is often used for soft-wrap control in mixed-script subtitles and docs; dropping it can change rendered line breaks and downstream token alignment. This explains diff in our subtitle BLEU microbench.

sanjay: we should do two things: (1) hotfix postproc compat branch to preserve ZWSP when adjacent to CJK; (2) add ZWSP cases to the multilingual dev bundle and the quant onboarding smoke matrix so future canaries catch this. Also consider a manifest lint that flags postproc tags older than main for whitespace-sensitive locales.

anya: +1. I'll open an infra issue and add a checklist item in the bring-up doc. pablo, can you open a quick PR to the compat branch adding a unit test for CJK+ZWSP+latin and preserve behavior?

pablo: opened PR #901 on postproc-compat with a unit test and a small change to not drop U+200B when surrounding chars include wide-script codepoints. CI kicked off.

infra-bot: [CI] postproc-compat PR #901 started  running 9 tests

mei: quick partial workaround: for the int8 canary we can patch the manifest to point to `postproc:main` for now until compat PR merges; that should restore baseline behavior for the smoke run.

sanjay: agreed. But we need to ensure pinned images for other quant experiments aren't silently carrying the old behavior. I'll add a gating lint in infra that fails onboarding if postproc tag < main for models with locale-sensitive flags.

infra-bot: [CI] postproc-compat PR #901 passed  9 tests :white_check_mark:

pablo: merged. re-ran the orion-v3 int8 smoke with postproc:main -> ZWSP preserved and BLEU delta back to 0.01.

anya: nice triage. follow-ups: (a) add ZWSP/ZWNBSP/other soft control spaces to dev bundle; (b) update onboarding doc with manifest pin checklist; (c) add an automated smoke that runs a tiny mixed-script subtitle set for every quant canary.

mei: noted. i'll wire the subtitle mini-suite into the quant CI. thanks all. :thumbsup:
